blurb: Santokh Yoga & Wellness offers yoga classes in hot and non-hot rooms and infrared sauna sessions using Sunlighten technology. The studio provides a clean, sacred space with a variety of class packages and memberships. Sauna sessions include towels and optional shower use, with health and safety protocols.
